established: All321 actual Mac tests passed with zero skips in72.2seconds, including both controlled delayed-resource lifecycle gates. Fixed official SDK acquisition/materialization and five fresh candidate repetitions passed.

The actual held-child control genuinely reached natural-zero: original baseline274, first delta1 with the exact child at.011seconds, final delta0 at.051seconds after release/natural exit0/reap/group gone. No baseline reset, exclusion or unrelated signal occurred.

The synchronized stress gate completed56/56 samples with zero retry/unknown/timeout, peakRSS4704.16796875MiB and max sample2.3419seconds. All988 churn children and three workers were reaped, workers exited0.

All11 stages exited0, reaped their exact leaders, verified groups gone and retained no cleanup failure. Known-child rejection/cleanup and controlled orphan/exec original-parent checks passed. First/monitor failure were null.

The fixed background baseline retained13 snapshots over121.721seconds with deltas [0,6,11,11,11,12,12,12,12,9,0,1,0]. Genuine zero was observed at the initial snapshot and again101.598 and121.721seconds later; all candidates were retained.

Every one of97 background candidate observations was captured without truncation and original-parent identity-verified, consistent with PID1 original parent. There were14 distinct opaque candidate identities:13 metadata-worker and one other. Four metadata identities were observed from10.038 through91.367seconds (81.329second observation span, nine snapshots).

The same-generation BSD-zombie fallback recovered one task-ESRCH event during stress; it remained in monitorDiagnostics. This was an internal inherited inventory recovery, not evidence that the delayed outer convergence retry occurred naturally.
limits: This run performed no Floorp build, although SDK extraction, tests, stress and other job filesystem work can trigger services. It demonstrates candidate creation and persistence without a Floorp build, not absence of job-induced/XPC activity.
PID1 original-parent consistency and process names do not establish non-writer status or exclusion/ownership authority. Sequential hints/origin queries are not an atomic exec snapshot.
Stable tags establish repeated observations of the same five-field identities within this process only; spans are sampled observations, not a continuous-liveness proof.

Genuine global delta0 is achievable in these short GitHub-host studies. Practical convergence after the specific long Rust build is still unproven, and the ended Recovery33/35 candidates cannot be retroactively queried or attributed.

Short controlled delayed-recheck success and recovered internal zombie handling do not establish that the Recovery35 natural task-unavailable failure is fixed. Its underlying exit-transition hypothesis remains unproven.
No checkpoint was created and no consumer, full host/XUL/package or native authentication was performed. The original native-host exit cause remains unknown.

All long execution remains on hold pending assessment of the candidate provenance/feasibility evidence. Recovery37 was not activated; this short pass does not automatically trigger another long trial.
